import_steps.condition: Send only after ASM> ; PASTE appends, so NEW must precede a replacement

hello_debug_steps.expected_output: A for hello-a, B for hello-b

branches.unexpected_prompt: Stop sending commands and identify the current context
branches.fresh_ASM: ASM reentry clears the document; restore saved numbered lines or NEW then PASTE
branches.edit_A_to_B: At ASM> after restoring hello-a, enter 40 CHAR EQU $42; then ASM and capture again
branches.numbered_replay: Numbered source preserves IDs; PASTE renumbers by tens and appends
branches.version_execution: VERSION origin $6E00 differs from output buffer $0200; kit compiles/captures it and does not issue a run/load/flash command
branches.capture: Save one complete LIST response and one complete S19 response, including final ASM> prompt
branches.persistence: No flash save or installer command belongs to this session
